desc: The LBE Unlimited AK G3 Trigger Group. This single stage trigger that features a flat trigger face/ profile and is a great upgrade or replacement of your AK47. The AK G3 trigger group offers an improved trigger pull of 3-4 lbs and eliminates the painful trigger slap common on other designs. All G3 components are heat treated to a 40-44C Rockwell hardness and manufactured out of tough 4140 tool-grade carbon steel. A precision secondary machining process ensures perfect fit and function.
